newsitem.title: USA: IVAC Medical Systems nine months gross profit up.
newsitem.headline: IVAC Medical Systems nine months gross profit up.

text.p: IVAC Medical Systems Inc said Wednesday that its gross profits for the nine months ended September 30 increased 26.4 percent to $71.3 million from $56.4 million.
The 1995 period included a one-time $14.8 million charge related to inventories.
IVAC's adjusted EBITDA increased 29.4 percent from $25.2 million for the nine months ended Sept. 30, 1995, to $32.6 million for the same period in 1996.
IVAC agreed in August to merge with IMED Corp, a subsidiary of Advanced Medical Inc. The deal recently received antitrust clearance.
